messages:
Priya Sinha: Proposed: when a service account impersonates, billing/quotas and routing should attribute to the impersonated project, not the caller org. This makes capacity/routing sane for delegated flows. Thoughts?
Jordan Kim: +1 to attributing to impersonated project for quota. But how do we handle cross-org impersonation? risk: abuse/misattribution.
Eliot Chen: Cross-org is the tricky one. If orgA impersonates SA in orgB, do we charge orgB? We need explicit consent and audit trace. Also telemetry must be clear.
Maya Patel: UX: console needs to show active impersonation chain on keys page and per-route breakdown. Otherwise support gets tons of tickets.
Priya Sinha: Proposal details: 1) routing/quota decision uses effective_project_id (impostor target) 2) billing uses owner_project_id unless explicit billing delegation flag set 3) audit log always records caller->impersonated chain
Jordan Kim: That split (routing vs billing) seems reasonable. Can we do a flag to opt-in to billing delegation? default no.
Eliot Chen: Agree opt-in for billing. Also need per-request telemetry fields: effective_project, billing_project, impersonation_chain. Example event schema:
```
{
  "event": "request.start",
  "effective_project": "proj-abc",
  "billing_project": "proj-123",
  "impersonation_chain": ["orgA/service-account","orgB/sa-target"]
}
```

Maya Patel: Good. Also UI needs a clear callout when creating SA keys: "This key may be used to bill project X if billing delegation enabled'."
Priya Sinha: Ops question: how would routing fallback work if target project is over quota? fall back to org-level policy, or reject? Current thought: fall back to caller org capacity only if caller org has explicit cross-org fallback policy.
Jordan Kim: Fallback should be opt-in per-project. Default reject with 429. We don't want silent cross-billing.
Eliot Chen: Telemetry/attribution: make sampling low-overhead. add a per-route meter tag `impersonation=true|false` so cost analytics can segment.
DeployBot: Deploy scheduled: canary rollout of impersonation attribution gate at 2026-03-20T02:00Z -> 10% traffic -> 24h -> promote if errors <0.2%.
Maya Patel: I'll add console copy + wireframe for the consent checkbox. Tagging @Jordan for policy text.
Jordan Kim: I'll draft policy and a short FAQ for support.
Priya Sinha: ok let's capture action items: Jordan -> policy + FAQ, Maya -> UI copy+wireframe, Eliot -> telemetry schema + perf budget, Eng-platform -> implement gating + canary. Sync tomorrow 10am.
Eliot Chen: Noted.
Priya Sinha: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
